en: This is a color illustrated postcard divided into four comic-like panels. The top left panel depicts a large white castle on a hill under a starry night sky, with three people in yellow clothing hunched over or examining something. The top right panel shows an interior room with cobwebs, spiders, and red stains resembling blood on the walls. The bottom left panel shows two people, a man in a red checked suit and a woman in a yellow coat and hat, walking towards the castle with luggage. The bottom right panel shows the same man and woman, now holding up bars of soap and bottles labeled in German, standing on a yellow floor. There is handwritten German text under each panel and at the top.
